blocks.title: 实体表单电子化（一期：还原 + 演示数据）

items.title: 原件识别还原
items.description: 上传图片 / PDF / Excel / Word 表单，按标记合同识别字段类型与固定命名，还原为同构的可交互网页。

items.title: mock 演示数据层
items.description: 预览页内嵌可一键填充的演示数据（下拉候选、计算联动、单号序列），数据层独立、终期可整体替换为真实取数。

items.title: 字段规格与确认门
items.description: F# 编号三体一致（schema / 预览页 / 规格文档），用户逐字段核对后批准定稿，自然语言指认修改。

items.title: Source recognition
items.description: Upload a form as image / PDF / Excel / Word; fields are typed by the marking contract and fixed names applied, then rebuilt as an interactive page.

items.title: Mock demo data layer
items.description: One-click demo fill (dropdown candidates, computed fields, sequence numbers); the data layer stays isolated for a future swap to real sources.

items.title: Field spec & confirmation gate
items.description: F# ids align across schema, preview page and spec doc; users verify field by field, then approve; revisions by natural language.
